annotations.title: Add a custom domain to a Cloudflare Pages project

description: Add a custom domain, a hostname, to a Cloudflare Pages project; the tool always asks first, since visitors to the hostname get the project's site once it is live. The hostname must be in a zone Cloudflare lets the account use; one it reserves or the account cannot use is refused. Adding creates no DNS record: the domain stays pending until a proxied CNAME record from the hostname to the project's pages.dev address exists (`cname` in the result), and then goes active in a few minutes; read cloudflare_pages_read domains for its status. DNS changes stay with the cloudflare_dns_* tools. `dns` holds the records already at that name in the account's zone: when no CNAME to `cname.content` is among them, create it with cloudflare_dns_record_add; when another record holds the name, the domain stays pending until the person decides what to do with it. The result holds the domain with its status and the validation it waits for; a step after the add that fails is listed under `errors` and the domain stays added. Removing a domain is cloudflare_pages_domain_remove.

account.description: The label of the credential pair to use, or "default" for the unlabeled one; left out, the unlabeled pair, else the only label.

name.description: The custom domain's hostname, as in www.example.com: lowercased, with an internationalized name turned into punycode and a trailing dot dropped. No wildcard.

project.description: The Pages project's name, as `list` shows it: 1–58 lowercase letters, digits and `-`, starting with a letter or digit.

name: cloudflare_pages_domain_add

cname.description: The DNS record the domain waits for; adding the domain creates none.

content.description: The record's target: the project's pages.dev address.

proxied.description: Whether the record is proxied; it must be.

records.description: The records named exactly like the hostname.

content.description: The record content, as Cloudflare shows it.

read_only.description: Whether another Cloudflare product manages the record (a Worker's custom domain, for one): it cannot be changed or deleted here, and the zone file leaves it out.

type.description: The record type (e.g. A, CNAME, MX, TXT).

dns.description: The records already at that name in the account's zone, or null when the account has no such zone. When no CNAME to `cname.content` is among them, create it with cloudflare_dns_record_add; when another record holds the name, the domain stays pending until the person decides what to do with it.

domain.description: The domain as Cloudflare reports it right after adding it: pending, not yet serving.

created_on.description: When the custom domain was created, or null.

name.description: The custom domain hostname, or null.

status.description: The custom domain status, or null.

error.description: The validation error message, or null.

method.description: The validation method (e.g. txt, http), or null.

txt_name.description: The TXT record name to configure, or null.

txt_value.description: The TXT record value to configure, or null.

validation.description: Validation details from validation_data, or null.

error.description: The verification error message, or null.

verification.description: Verification details from verification_data, or null.

zone_id.description: The zone id (from zone_tag), or null.

errors.description: The steps that failed after the write was done, keyed by step, as `code: message`; absent when none did.
